77007 In Wales and Scotland, an establishment is a care home if it is accommodation in which a care

home service is provided1. That is, a service that provides accommodation, together with nursing,

Concept role: dwp:Applicability.","text":"Source-bounded navigation through DMG 78065–78076, separate from ignoring a person’s presence under 78077–78080 and from deciding whether partners remain one household. Normal residence is where a person usually lives: exceptional visits or absences are disregarded, and temporary absence does not itself change the normal home. DMG 78067 requires factual consideration of time, frequency, permanence, intentions, circumstances, degree of sharing, services, other accommodation and liabilities. An address, university term or overnight stay alone does not settle that assessment. Sharing only a bathroom, lavatory or communal area, or separate legal payment liabilities to the same landlord, has the captured sharing exceptions. Kitchen sharing can exist without entering or using it when personal items are stored or meals prepared there; merely passing through to a self-contained flat is different. DMG 78072–78075 require the contractual capacity and intention to create legal relations, an obligation for occupation from a recognised source of law, and the stipulated connection between non-payment and ending the licence or lease; another liability to a third party is not the same-landlord condition. Retain the England-and-Wales scope and presumption in the captured capacity passage rather than infer incapacity from a diagnosis. For an overnight carer, establish the separate address, actual use and frequency, postal address and Council Tax registration. All residence and contractual facts remain unknown until evidenced. A finding about this residence condition is not a finding of benefit entitlement, ignored-person status or continuing couple membership."}}],"unresolved_terms":["caring","someone"]}
